title: nmdal-project
summary: A Jupyter-notebook machine-learning project that trains classifiers (e.g. MLPClassifier, XGBClassifier) on an imbalanced dataset, using SMOTE and random undersampling alongside synthetic oversampling. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) is fit on the data and used with SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic minority-class samples for the classification pipeline.
